headline: CISA orders Citrix NetScaler patch after zero-days exploited
summary: Citrix confirmed two critical NetScaler remote code execution zero-days, tracked as CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, are being exploited in attacks and released fixes. CISA then ordered U.S. federal agencies to patch the exploited flaws by Wednesday, in an update one outlet says also fixed a third critical vulnerability and five other serious issues.

claims.statement: Citrix confirmed two critical NetScaler RCE zero-days, tracked as CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, are being exploited in attacks.

sources.quote: Citrix has confirmed that two critical NetScaler remote code execution vulnerabilities, tracked as CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, are being exploited in attacks

claims.statement: CISA ordered U.S. federal agencies to patch the exploited Citrix NetScaler flaws by Wednesday.

sources.quote: CISA orders feds to patch exploited Citrix flaws by Wednesday

The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has ordered U.S. government agencies over the weekend to secure their systems against attacks exploiting two critical Citrix NetScaler vulnerabilities.

claims.statement: The patch also fixed a total of three critical vulnerabilities plus five other serious issues.

sources.quote: Sunday NetScaler patch dump fixes trio of critical vulns and five more serious messes

discrepancies.explanation: One report describes two critical NetScaler zero-days under attack, while another's patch roundup counts three critical vulnerabilities fixed in the same update.
